answer: Unrepeatable challenge lineage. Each identity must solve a fresh, nonce-derived challenge seeded by the last accepted answer, so copied proofs fail; a gale of precomputation is useless because the chain re-keys per round. Enforcement requires the answer to carry a verifiable trace of unique work, and any replay is rejected at the ember of validation before settlement. An attacker pays one full compute cycle per identity per round, and sybil clusters scale cost linearly with each added node rather than amortizing, while a plume of parallel attempts still burns distinct resources.
